tip: When 'je' follows the verb, as after fronted 'zonder oefening', drop the -t: 'word je', not 'wordt je'.
After the ordinal 'de eerste', use 'om ... te' for 'the first to do something': 'de eerste om te signaleren'.
Separable verbs split around 'te': 'uitproberen' becomes 'uit te proberen', with the prefix left of te.
'Waardoor' = as a result of which, and it sends its verb to the clause end: 'waardoor zij het feest miste'.
'Dromen' pairs with fixed 'van', which becomes 'ervan' before 'om te': 'droomt ervan om te schrijven'.
'Tenzij' = unless and opens a subordinate clause, so the following main clause inverts: 'annuleren wij'.
